title: Why 32‑Year‑Old Homebuyers Overpay by $12,000

scenes.text: At 32, buying a house can cost you an extra $12,000 you never saw coming.
scenes.query: 32 year old home purchase hidden costs

scenes.text: The common belief is that owning is always cheaper than renting after a few years.
scenes.label: Owning beats renting fast

scenes.text: Data shows first‑time buyers in high‑cost markets often pay $12,000–$15,000 more in closing fees, property taxes, and maintenance in the first three years than they would have saved renting.
scenes.label: Hidden fees add $12k+
